Sure, my name is Ethan Garcia and my zip code is 80280. I don’t really remember which email I used, though. Is that enough to find my orders?

Yes, please go ahead and upgrade everything as you described. Use my gift card for the price difference, and if there’s any leftover amount to pay, let me know. I’m fine with following the exchange process for the delivered orders.
Yes, that all sounds good. Please go ahead and calculate the total price difference. If my gift card isn’t enough, I can pay the rest with PayPal. Let me know what the final amount is.
Yes, please use my gift card first and then charge the rest to my PayPal. Go ahead and process everything. Thanks!

I see. I thought those orders had already arrived, but if they’re not delivered yet, I’ll wait until they are. For now, just process the upgrades for the pending order. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
Great, thanks for your help. That’s all I needed for now.
